proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13161 saptāha means a period of seven days and gives Nepali sātā “week”. Rajasthani sapta/sapto preserve learned pt with regional final adaptation; this family link leaves learned or neighboring Indo-Aryan transmission open. Joint comparison: NDu saptā “week” matches reviewed had saptā “week” (f_rf3isi4lccmes). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
